description: Defines the interface for a PDSCH modulator class, including configuration parameters and modulation method, within a 5G NR physical layer implementation.

classes.name: pdsch_modulator
classes.description: Interface for PDSCH modulation in 5G NR, supporting codeword and codeblock modulation according to TS38.211.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Performs modulation of PDSCH codewords onto the resource grid based on provided configuration.
